task: skeptic R19RT-2 (UP test guards: LastSubmissionDate freshness + BLIND k=0)
reason: Guard (a) is factually wrong, and our own downloads show it. LastSubmissionDate is the MAX submit time over our SCORED files. It is not the submit time of the file that scored last. Our row (TeamId 16810638) in experiments/lb_poll/ladder_watch: at 04:13Z LSD 21:17:47 (exp70a), count 41. At 04:31Z, after exp70e (submitted EARLIER, 21:15:23) had scored, LSD was still 21:17:47 and the count was 42. Under guard (a), that valid S1 for exp70e would never have counted as valid. The same failure hits the 28 Sep W1 plan (R19RT-1 (3)): CI is submitted at 00:05Z, SEC at 00:10Z, and CI runs ~2 h longer (L ~9.6-9.8 h), so SEC very likely scores first. LSD then stays 00:10 and CI's S1 never becomes 'valid'. The CI read is exactly the one the plan hopes for, so guard (a) would stall it into AMBIGUOUS. The primary freshness check already in force is correct: R13-A1 (2), SubmissionCount == base + our refs COMPLETE (40->41->42->43->44->46 matched every event). Guard (b), BLIND at k = 0, is logically right but has near-zero value. In e10_watch 'our team' lines, k (teams above us in the 0.954 block) was 4-5 over the last ~10 h and never near 0. It is also only the extreme case of the general low-power issue (unknown gap to the next team above), which R19RT-1 (2)(d) already covers with N4 = delta <= ~1e-5. Logging needs no new API call (the E10 snapshot keeps LSD, SubmissionCount and all rows >= 0.953). The whole thing is procedure, not a score lever, with no private-LB value.
fix: Replace guard (a) in R19RT-1 (2)(a) with: S1 = the first LB download after the ref's terminal poll.log header in which our SubmissionCount == S0 count + the number of our refs that turned COMPLETE in between (R13-A1 (2) primary; an ERROR's effect on the count is to be recorded at first sight). LastSubmissionDate is a secondary check only: it must equal max(submit time of our COMPLETE refs), and it equals the ref's own submit time only when that ref is our latest-submitted scored file. Keep BLIND (k = 0 at S0 -> '?', not N4) as a one-line log field (k, S0/S1 file names, SubmissionCount, LSD, TeamIds passed from the CSV); do not spend more time on it.
realistic_gain: 0 on private and 0 on public score (procedure only). Adopting guard (a) as written risks losing the CI (exp76a) read on 28 Sep with probability ~0.6-0.8 (out-of-order completion is likely under the 00:05/00:10 stagger). With the fix, the read works as intended. BLIND fires with P < ~0.05.
